facts.fact: The World Bank completion report (26 August 2022) describes the National Strategy for the Modernization of the Administration and ICT 2012-2016, with pillars covering broadband and an IXP, a legal environment for the digital economy, a data centre and government intranet, local content and digital services, and the digital economy and sectoral technologies; its stated period ended in 2016, and the report links its text on the tic.gov.mr site.
